name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions:
• Lie on a flat bench with feet planted on the floor.
• Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
• Unrack and lower the bar to your mid-chest with control.
• Press back up to full arm extension without locking out aggressively.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions:
• Set the bench to a 30-45° incline and lie back.
• Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
• Lower the bar to your upper chest.
• Press back up to full arm extension.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions:
• Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
• Press the dumbbells up until your arms are extended.
• Lower them back down with control until you feel a stretch in your chest.
• Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows throughout.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions:
• Set the bench to a 30-45° incline and sit back holding a dumbbell in each hand.
• Press the dumbbells up and slightly together at the top.
• Lower them back down with control.
• Keep your shoulder blades pulled back into the bench.

name: Push Up
instructions:
• Hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, body in a straight line from head to heels.
• Brace your core and keep your hips level.
• Lower your chest to the floor, elbows at roughly 45°.
• Press back up to full arm extension without letting your hips sag or pike.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions:
• Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
• Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout.
• Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch.
• Bring them back together over your chest.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions:
• Stand centered between two cable towers, handles set at chest height.
• Step forward slightly with a soft bend in your elbows.
• Bring your hands together in front of you in a wide arc.
• Return to the start with control.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions:
• Sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles at chest height.
• Press forward until your arms are extended.
• Return with control until you feel a stretch in your chest.
• Keep your shoulder blades pinned to the pad.

name: Chest Dip
instructions:
• Support yourself on parallel bars with arms straight.
• Lean your torso forward slightly.
• Lower until your shoulders drop below your elbows.
• Press back up to full arm extension.

name: Pull Up
instructions:
• Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width.
• Engage your shoulder blades before pulling.
• Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
• Lower back down to a full hang with control.

name: Chin Up
instructions:
• Hang from a bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
• Engage your shoulder blades before pulling.
• Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
• Lower back down to a full hang with control.

name: Dead Hang
instructions:
• Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended.
• Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
• Keep your core lightly braced.
• Hold the position for time.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions:
• Sit with thighs secured under the pad, grip the bar wider than shoulder-width.
• Lean back very slightly and pull your shoulder blades down.
• Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
• Let it rise back to full extension with control.

name: Barbell Bent Over Row
instructions:
• Hinge at the hips with a flat back and slight knee bend, bar hanging at arm's length.
• Brace your core to protect your lower back.
• Pull the bar to your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.
• Lower it back down with control.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions:
• Place one knee and hand on a bench, other foot planted on the floor.
• Let the dumbbell hang at arm's length.
• Pull the dumbbell up to your hip, keeping your torso still.
• Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions:
• Sit with knees slightly bent, feet braced, grip the handle at arm's length.
• Sit up tall with a neutral spine.
• Pull the handle to your torso while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
• Extend back out with control.

name: Machine Row
instructions:
• Sit with chest against the pad, grip the handles.
• Pull the handles toward you while squeezing your shoulder blades.
• Pause briefly at full contraction.
• Extend your arms back out with control.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions:
• Stand with the bar over mid-foot, feet hip-width apart.
• Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs.
• Brace your core, flatten your back, and drive through your heels to stand up.
• Keep the bar close to your body the whole way, then lower it back down with control.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions:
• Stand with a wide stance and toes turned out, bar over mid-foot.
• Grip the bar inside your knees.
• Drive through your heels to stand up, keeping your chest up and back flat.
• Lower the bar back down with control.

name: Good Morning
instructions:
• Rest a bar across your upper back.
• Soften your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
• Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
• Drive your hips forward to return to standing.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions:
• Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
• Stand tall with shoulders back and core braced.
• Walk for distance or time with short, controlled steps.
• Set the weights down with control, not a drop.

name: Straight Arm Pulldown
instructions:
• Stand facing a high cable with a straight bar attachment.
• Keep your arms straight throughout.
• Pull the bar down to your thighs using your lats.
• Let it rise back to shoulder height with control.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions:
• Hold a bar in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
• Stand tall with a neutral spine.
• Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
• Lower with control — no rolling or curling the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions:
• Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
• Stand tall with a neutral spine.
• Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
• Lower with control.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions:
• Hold the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside shoulder-width.
• Brace your core and glutes.
• Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are locked out.
• Lower back to the shoulders with control, without arching your lower back.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions:
• Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
• Brace your core.
• Press the dumbbells straight overhead until your arms are extended.
• Lower back to shoulder height with control.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions:
• Sit with your back against the pad, grip the handles at shoulder height.
• Press the handles straight up until your arms are extended.
• Pause briefly at the top.
• Lower back down with control.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
• Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
• Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
• Lower with control.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions:
• Stand side-on to a low cable, handle in the far hand.
• Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
• Raise your arm out to shoulder height across your body.
• Lower with control, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
• Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
• Raise one or both arms straight out in front to shoulder height.
• Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
instructions:
• Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, dumbbells hanging below your shoulders.
• Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
• Raise the dumbbells out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
• Lower with control.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions:
• Set a rope attachment at head height on a cable machine.
• Grip the rope with both hands, palms facing in.
• Pull it toward your face while flaring your elbows out wide.
• Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end, then return with control.

name: Barbell Upright Row
instructions:
• Hold the bar with hands just inside shoulder-width, arms extended.
• Pull the bar straight up along your body, leading with your elbows.
• Raise it to about chest height.
• Lower with control.

name: Wall Arm Raise
instructions:
• Stand or sit with your back flat against a wall, arms at your sides.
• Press your lower back, upper back, and head into the wall.
• Slide your arms up overhead while staying in contact with the wall.
• Slide back down with control and repeat.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions:
• Stand holding the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
• Pin your elbows to your sides.
• Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
• Lower with control to full arm extension.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended.
• Pin your elbows to your sides.
• Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
• Lower with control.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing each other.
• Pin your elbows to your sides.
• Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
• Lower with control.

name: EZ Bar Curl
instructions:
• Grip the angled bar at the inner handles, arms extended.
• Pin your elbows to your sides.
• Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
• Lower with control.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions:
• Rest the back of your upper arms on the preacher pad.
• Grip the bar with an underhand grip.
• Curl the weight up toward your shoulders.
• Lower it fully to stretch the biceps.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions:
• Sit back on an incline bench with arms hanging straight down.
• Keep your upper arms still throughout.
• Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
• Lower with control to a full stretch.

name: Cable Curl
instructions:
• Stand holding a low cable bar or handle, arms extended.
• Pin your elbows to your sides.
• Curl it up toward your shoulders.
• Lower with control.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions:
• Stand facing a high cable with a bar or rope attachment.
• Pin your elbows to your sides.
• Push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
• Let it rise back with control.

name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions:
• Face away from a low cable, gripping a rope attachment behind your head.
• Keep your upper arms close to your ears.
• Extend your arms overhead.
• Return with control to a full stretch.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions:
• Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead, arms extended.
• Keep your upper arms close to your ears.
• Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending at the elbows.
• Extend back up to the start.

name: EZ Bar Skull Crusher
instructions:
• Lie on a bench holding the bar above your chest, arms extended.
• Keep your upper arms still throughout.
• Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
• Extend back up to the start.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
instructions:
• Lie on a flat bench with hands just inside shoulder-width.
• Keep your elbows tucked close to your body.
• Lower the bar to your chest.
• Press back up to full arm extension.

name: Triceps Dip
instructions:
• Support yourself on parallel bars or a bench with arms straight.
• Keep your torso upright to emphasize triceps.
• Lower until your elbows reach about 90°.
• Press back up to full arm extension.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
instructions:
• Rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench, palm facing up, dumbbell in hand.
• Let your wrist hang off the edge.
• Curl the dumbbell up using just your wrist.
• Lower with control to a full stretch.

name: Plank
instructions:
• Forearms and toes on the floor, elbows under your shoulders.
• Body in a straight line from head to heels.
• Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
• Hold the position without letting your hips sag or rise.

name: Crunch
instructions:
• Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
• Hands lightly supporting your head or crossed on your chest.
• Curl your shoulders up off the floor toward your knees.
• Lower with control.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions:
• Kneel in front of a high cable with a rope attachment held by your head.
• Hinge from your waist, not your hips.
• Crunch your torso down toward your knees using your abs.
• Return to the start with control.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions:
• Hang from a bar with arms fully extended.
• Brace your core before moving.
• Raise your legs up toward your chest, straight or slightly bent.
• Lower with control without swinging.

name: Russian Twist
instructions:
• Sit with your knees bent and torso leaned back slightly, feet lifted or planted.
• Hold a weight with both hands in front of your chest.
• Rotate your torso to tap the weight on the floor beside one hip.
• Rotate to the other side and repeat.

name: Cable Woodchopper
instructions:
• Stand side-on to a high (or low) cable, gripping the handle with both hands.
• Rotate your torso and hips to pull the handle diagonally across your body.
• Finish near the opposite hip.
• Return with control, then switch sides.

name: Back Extension
instructions:
• Position your hips on the pad of a back extension bench, legs secured.
• Cross your arms over your chest or behind your head.
• Lower your torso down with control.
• Raise back up to a straight line without hyperextending.

name: Superman
instructions:
• Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
• Brace your core.
• Simultaneously raise your arms, chest, and legs off the floor.
• Hold briefly, then lower with control.

name: Side Plank
instructions:
• Lie on your side propped up on one forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
• Stack your feet or stagger them for balance.
• Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
• Hold the position while keeping your hips square.

name: Bird Dog
instructions:
• Start on hands and knees, back flat.
• Brace your core.
• Extend one arm and the opposite leg out straight.
• Hold briefly, return, and switch sides.

name: Dead Bug
instructions:
• Lie on your back with arms extended toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90°.
• Press your lower back into the floor.
• Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
• Return to the start and switch sides.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions:
• Rest the bar across your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart.
• Brace your core and unrack the bar.
• Squat down until your hips drop below your knees.
• Drive back up through your heels to standing.

name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions:
• Rack the bar across the front of your shoulders, elbows up.
• Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
• Squat down until your hips drop below your knees.
• Drive back up through your heels.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions:
• Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest with both hands.
• Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
• Squat down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
• Drive back up through your heels.

name: Leg Press
instructions:
• Sit in the machine with feet shoulder-width on the platform.
• Release the safety and lower the weight by bending your knees toward your chest.
• Stop just short of your lower back rounding.
• Press back up without locking out your knees.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions:
• Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
• Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
• Push off your front foot to stand and step forward into the next lunge.
• Continue alternating legs for the set.

name: Barbell Lunge
instructions:
• Rest a bar across your upper back.
• Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
• Push back to standing.
• Repeat on the other leg.

name: Bodyweight Lunge
instructions:
• Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
• Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
• Push back to standing.
• Repeat on the other leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions:
• Stand a couple feet in front of a bench, rear foot elevated on it.
• Keep your torso upright.
• Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front leg.
• Drive back up through your front heel.

name: Machine Leg Extension
instructions:
• Sit with the pad resting on your shins, knees at the edge of the seat.
• Grip the side handles for stability.
• Extend your legs until straight.
• Lower back down with control.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions:
• Hold the bar at hip level, feet hip-width apart.
• Hinge back at the hips with a slight knee bend, keeping the bar close to your legs.
• Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
• Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions:
• Sit with the pad against the back of your ankles, legs extended.
• Grip the side handles for stability.
• Curl your legs down and back.
• Return with control.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions:
• Lie face down with the pad against the back of your ankles.
• Grip the side handles for stability.
• Curl your legs up toward your glutes.
• Lower with control.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions:
• Sit on the ground with your upper back braced against a bench, bar across your hips.
• Plant your feet flat, knees bent.
• Drive your hips up until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
• Lower with control.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions:
• Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
• Arms at your sides for stability.
• Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
• Lower with control.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions:
• Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and secure it to one ankle.
• Hold the machine frame for balance.
• Kick that leg straight back and up while keeping your torso stable.
• Return with control, then switch sides.

name: Machine Hip Adductor
instructions:
• Sit with the pads against the inside of your knees, legs spread.
• Grip the side handles for stability.
• Squeeze your legs together against the resistance.
• Return with control.

name: Machine Hip Abductor
instructions:
• Sit with the pads against the outside of your knees, legs together.
• Grip the side handles for stability.
• Push your legs apart against the resistance.
• Return with control.

name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
• Find a stable, level surface.
• Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
• Lower your heels back down with control.

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions:
• Sit with a dumbbell resting on each knee.
• Feet flat on the floor or a raised platform.
• Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
• Lower your heels back down with control.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions:
• Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
• Hinge at the hips to swing the kettlebell back between your legs.
• Drive your hips forward explosively to swing it up to chest height.
• Let it swing back down and repeat.

name: Air Squat
instructions:
• Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
• Keep your chest up.
• Squat down until your hips drop below your knees.
• Drive back up through your heels.

name: Deep Squat
instructions:
• Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out.
• Keep your heels planted throughout.
• Squat down as low as comfortable.
• Hold or gently pulse at the bottom to build hip and ankle mobility.

name: Cossack Squat (Kazak Squat)
instructions:
• Stand in a wide stance, toes pointed slightly out.
• Shift your weight onto one leg.
• Bend that knee to lower into a deep side squat while keeping the other leg straight.
• Push back to center and repeat on the other side.

name: Single Leg Rear Deadlift
instructions:
• Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
• Hinge forward at the hips while extending the other leg straight back.
• Reach toward the floor (with or without weight) as you hinge.
• Return to standing and repeat, then switch legs.

name: Kneeling Hip Drive
instructions:
• Kneel on one knee with the other foot planted in front of you.
• Keep your torso upright.
• Drive your hips forward and up by squeezing the glute of the kneeling leg.
• Return with control and repeat.

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
instructions:
• Sit with one knee bent 90° in front of you and the other bent 90° to the side.
• Keep your hands on the floor for support.
• Rotate through your hips to switch the position of your legs to the opposite side.
• Continue alternating.

name: Single Knee Fallout
instructions:
• Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
• Keep your pelvis still and core braced.
• Let one knee fall out to the side as far as comfortable.
• Return and repeat, then switch sides.

name: Double Knee Fallout
instructions:
• Lie on your back with knees bent and feet together.
• Keep your core braced.
• Let both knees fall out to the sides together.
• Return with control.

name: Mini Happy Baby
instructions:
• Lie on your back.
• Grab the outsides of your feet or shins.
• Gently pull your knees toward your armpits.
• Hold to open the hips, breathing steadily.

name: Frog Stretch
instructions:
• Start on hands and knees.
• Widen your knees out to the sides as far as comfortable.
• Rock your hips back toward your heels.
• Hold to stretch the inner thighs, breathing steadily.

name: Bodyweight Neck Curl
instructions:
• Lie on your back with knees bent.
• Keep your shoulders relaxed on the floor.
• Gently nod your chin toward your chest to curl your neck up off the floor.
• Lower with control.

name: Treadmill Run
instructions:
• Start the belt at a comfortable warm-up pace.
• Keep an upright posture with relaxed shoulders.
• Settle into a steady pace or interval pattern.
• Cool down with a few minutes of walking at the end.

name: Stationary Bike Ride
instructions:
• Adjust the seat so your knee has a slight bend at full leg extension.
• Start pedaling at an easy warm-up pace.
• Settle into a steady pace or interval pattern.
• Cool down with a few minutes of easy pedaling at the end.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions:
• Strap in and grip the handle with both hands.
• Drive through your legs first.
• Lean back slightly, then pull the handle to your ribs.
• Reverse the sequence — arms, then torso, then legs — to return.

name: Kettlebell Reverse Curl + Upright Row
instructions:
• Hold the kettlebell with an overhand grip, arms extended.
• Curl it up toward your shoulders.
• Continue pulling it up along your body to chest height, leading with your elbows.
• Reverse the motion back down to the start.

name: Kettlebell Curl + Halo
instructions:
• Hold the kettlebell in both hands at your waist.
• Curl it up to your shoulders.
• Circle it around your head in one direction, keeping your core braced.
• Curl back down to the start.

name: Kettlebell Curl + Press
instructions:
• Hold the kettlebell at your shoulder.
• Curl it up to your shoulder if starting from a lower position.
• Press it straight overhead.
• Reverse the motion back down to the start.

name: Kettlebell Curl + Pullover
instructions:
• Hold the kettlebell in both hands at your waist.
• Curl it up to your shoulders.
• Lower it back and overhead in a pullover arc while lying or standing.
• Reverse the motion back down to the start.

name: Close-Grip Kettlebell Push-Up
instructions:
• Grip the kettlebell handle with both hands close together (or place hands close together on the floor).
• Body in a straight line from head to heels.
• Lower your chest down toward your hands.
• Press back up to full arm extension.
